description: Defines the CodeCoverageCommands class for running code coverage analysis within SuiteCRM, extending Robo Tasks, with methods for executing PHPUnit with coverage options and detecting CI environment.

classes.name: CodeCoverageCommands
classes.description: A Robo command class for executing code coverage analysis in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: codeCoverage
methods.description: Main method to run code coverage, optionally in CI environment.

methods.name: isEnvironmentTravisCI
methods.description: Checks if the environment is Travis CI.

methods.name: getCommitRangeForTravisCi
methods.description: Retrieves the Travis CI commit range environment variable.

methods.name: generateCodeCoverageFile
methods.description: Executes the command to generate code coverage report.

methods.name: getCodeCoverageCommand
methods.description: Builds the command string to run PHPUnit with coverage options.
